baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيئَتْ وُجُوهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا
baseline_models.mechanism: Direct sight and closing distance defeat a stance of concealment: the denied object becomes unavoidable while the adverse result registers on the deniers' outward-facing surface.

activation_trace.role: Eye-and-insight perception supplies the direct encounter that replaces distance with witnessed presence.
Movement into proximity closes the space in which denial could remain abstract.
The branch of affliction and what causes distress makes the encounter visibly adverse.
The face as the visible front turns inward shock into publicly readable evidence.
Concealment of truth identifies the prior stance that the close sight now defeats.

changed_reading.before: They see a nearby threat and their faces become distressed.
changed_reading.after: Their former concealment is converted into face-level evidence: proximity makes the denied object present, and their own exposed fronts testify to the collapse of denial.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَقِيلَ هَذَا الَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِ تَدَّعُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: A passive pronouncement points to a present 'this' and identifies it with their sustained speech-act. What had been projected verbally toward an absent object returns as an object placed before them.

activation_trace.role: An uttered statement performs the identifying verdict rather than merely reporting their reaction.
Occurrence through past time gives their speech the force of a sustained prior practice.
Calling and verbally inclining something toward oneself supports the demand-or-invocation side of the speech-act.
Claiming a right or affiliation preserves the live alternative that they had asserted a counter-claim rather than simply called.

changed_reading.before: They are told that this is what they used to call for.
changed_reading.after: The utterance stages an evidentiary reversal: their recurring demand or claim is materialized, pointed out as 'this,' and returned to them as its own answer.

baseline_models.mechanism: The plural faces can carry more than facial expression: branches of social standing and the valid face of an affair allow the pronounced encounter to spoil both their public bearing and the apparent correctness of their case.

activation_trace.role: Face as standing, rank, or leading representation expands the damage from expression to public status.
The sound face of an argument or affair makes their spoiled faces also image a case shown unsound.
Faulting and exposing defect supplies the evaluative collapse of their former position.
The audible pronouncement makes that loss of standing a public judgment.

changed_reading.before: Their faces show fear when the threat appears.
changed_reading.after: Their visible distress also figures the public collapse of their standing and argument under an announced identification.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier sight is ordered back over creation until it returns rebuffed and exhausted; the focus reverses that audit. The deniers no longer inspect for a defect in what is shown, because the close object exposes defect and exhaustion on their own faces.

activation_trace.role: Direct seeing anchors the final scene in the same perceptual activity as the earlier audit.
The visible front becomes the surface on which the audit's result is now displayed.
Returning something to its prior point supplies the repeated inspection that precedes final sight.
Ocular inspection establishes sight as an active test rather than passive reception.
The doubled occurrence sustains the visual audit until sight itself returns altered.
Sight returning dim and worn supplies the failure-state later transferred from the observer's gaze to the deniers' faces.
Exhausted, spent capacity gives the earlier visual sequence its terminal limit and sharpens the reversal in 67:27.

structural_cues: 67:3-4 repeatedly return sight to its object and end with sight itself rebuffed and exhausted.
67:27 moves the adverse bodily result from the inspecting gaze to the faces of those confronted by what they see.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated inspection and an exhausted return of sight; I supply the arrow from failed inspection to a final observer-object reversal in which the viewers are exposed; a live alternative is that 67:27 only continues the sight motif without making that reversal causal.

changed_reading.before: They finally see the threatened object nearby.
changed_reading.after: The final sight closes a surah-long visual audit by reversing it: those who sought or presumed defect become the visibly defective side of the encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves from voiced denial to confession and from the hidden interior to overt manifestation. In the focus, the face completes that sequence by becoming an involuntary statement: concealment can no longer keep the originating stance inside.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the concealment that the context progressively strips away.
The outward-facing surface functions as an involuntary public disclosure.
Contradiction of truth establishes the earlier verbal stance that later disclosure overturns.
Acknowledging and yielding supplies the explicit confession-stage that the face later performs without words.
Hiding something inwardly defines the interior pole of the disclosure mechanism.
Becoming manifest to the eye defines the outward pole realized on the faces in 67:27.
The interior as the source from which acts issue links concealed orientation to its later facial result.

structural_cues: 67:9-11 sequences denial, retrospective acknowledgment, and confession.
67:13 pairs concealed and overt speech while locating knowledge in the interiors from which acts issue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, confession, and the secret-overt opposition; I infer the arrow by which the known interior becomes readable on the face; alternatively the facial distress may be only an affective reaction with no confessional function.

changed_reading.after: Their faces become involuntary testimony: what denial had covered and speech had contested is forced from the interior into visible acknowledgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The condemned retrospectively distinguish hearing from understanding, and the later faculty list joins hearing, sights, and hearts. The focus sight is therefore not bare optics: it is the terminal, compelled cognition that arrives after receptive understanding was not exercised.

activation_trace.role: Seeing as inward judgment and considered recognition lets the final perception exceed ocular contact.
Hearing as understanding and compliance marks the receptive cognition they say could have changed their outcome.
Reason as a restraint from ignorance supplies the unrealized judgment that final sight can no longer postpone.
The created faculty of receptive understanding places accountability behind the eventual visual encounter.
Heart-sight or insight joins the faculty list to the focus's moment of unavoidable recognition.

structural_cues: 67:10 frames non-hearing and non-reasoning as the missed counterfactual to the condemned state.
67:23 coordinates hearing, sights, and hearts before remarking on the paucity of responsive gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the missed hearing-reasoning pair and the coordinated faculties; I infer a temporal arrow from unused receptive cognition to compelled final recognition; alternatively the focus may describe visual terror without any inward assent.

changed_reading.before: They visually perceive the threat when it is close.
changed_reading.after: They undergo too-late integrated recognition: sight finally compels the conclusion that hearing and reason could once have reached responsively.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reverent fear while the object is hidden is contrasted with distress only after seeing it close. The focus thus marks not simply fear, but the loss of the earlier moral interval in which response could occur without coercive visibility.

activation_trace.role: Actual sight supplies the forced-visible pole of the contrast.
Closing proximity removes the remaining interval for an unseen response.
Fear joined with reverence supplies a responsive posture before visible compulsion.
What is screened from the eyes defines the earlier condition under which the contrasting response remains meaningful.

structural_cues: 67:12 attaches reverent fear to an unseen condition, whereas 67:27 couples sight, nearness, and facial distress.
The two responses are assigned contrasting visibility conditions rather than merely different emotional intensities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unseen reverence and close visible distress; I infer the arrow from delayed response to loss of voluntary moral space; alternatively the two clauses may contrast groups without implying a temporal opportunity structure.

changed_reading.after: Nearness announces that the unseen interval of responsive trust has closed; recognition now occurs through compelled presence and yields distress rather than reverence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior contrast between face-down movement and upright movement on a straight path activates 'faces' as orientation-bearing fronts. Their spoiled faces in the focus are not only expressive surfaces; they are the exposed endpoints of a misdirected course now brought up against its destination.

activation_trace.role: Face as direction and destination anchors the trajectory reading in the focus noun itself.
Approach into nearness supplies the endpoint at which orientation becomes consequence.
Being overturned or cast onto the face supplies the bodily geometry of a misdirected course.
The face functioning as a direction in the comparison turns the later plural faces into trajectory-bearing fronts.
Direction, course, and intended aim establish orientation as the comparison's evaluative axis.
Upright integrity supplies the bodily and moral alternative to face-down movement.
The straight road gives the contrasting course a determinate path and makes the focus encounter read as arrival.

structural_cues: 67:22 builds a two-course comparison around walking posture, face orientation, guidance, uprightness, and road.
67:27 repeats the face and approach fields at the moment of encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the face-down versus upright-path comparison and the focus's nearness plus faces; I infer an arrow from chosen orientation to encountered endpoint; alternatively 67:22 may remain a separate ethical simile with no spatial continuation into 67:27.

changed_reading.before: Their faces register distress at what has approached.
changed_reading.after: Their faces reveal where their course has carried them: the face-down orientation reaches its endpoint and becomes visibly untenable at close range.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence asks when 'this promise' will occur and challenges the truthfulness of the warning, then withholds its timing while retaining a clarifying warner. The focus answers with event grammar and a deictic identification: not a date, but the promised threat itself arriving close enough to be seen. This sharpens تَدَّعُونَ toward provocative demand while preserving claim as an alternative.

activation_trace.role: Calling something toward oneself supports the reading of a provocative demand now answered by arrival.
Assertion of a claim keeps open the alternative that their truth-challenge, not a request for haste, is being returned.
The pronounced identification supplies the answer that replaces an announced date.
Their spoken question establishes the prior speech-act answered by the focus pronouncement.
A threat-specific promise identifies the adverse object whose nearness spoils their faces.
An appointment bounded by time or place turns their 'when' into a demand for coordinates that the focus answers by presence.
Fulfillment of promise in act converts their truth-challenge into witnessed verification.
Warning intended to awaken caution supplies the speech they treated as challengeable before its object arrived.
Clarification by speech or sign makes the focus's 'this is that' the culminating disclosure of the warning.

structural_cues: 67:25-27 forms an adjacent question, timing-limitation, and encounter sequence.
The deictic هَذَا recurs from 'this promise' to 'this is that,' while فَلَمَّا replaces the requested date with event arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the timing challenge, threat-promise, warning, and immediate deictic identification; I infer that the focus object is the challenged promise and that تَدَّعُونَ leans toward provocative demand; the live alternative is the broader sense of what they claimed without a demand for haste.

changed_reading.before: They are reproached for having called for or claimed the thing now seen.
changed_reading.after: Their 'when is this promise?' is answered as an appointment kept: no date is supplied, but the threat arrives into deictic, visible nearness and verifies the warning against its challengers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's form-distant د ع ع mapping and a falling-sequence branch beside the ordinary call/claim senses of تَدَّعُونَ. It remains anchored in that exact focus word and is materially activated by contextual throwing and face-down tumbling. Downstream prose should present it only as a sound-and-motion echo, never as a replacement translation of تَدَّعُونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَدَّعُونَ, with the alternate mapped root د ع ع and the regular root's successive-fall branch

activation_trace.role: The alternate mapping's forceful push gives the habitual provocation a pressure-and-thrust echo.
Successive falling or collapse adds a cascading result while remaining tied to the focus word's regular mapped inventory.
Throwing something until it lies cast supplies the contextual motion that activates the thrust echo.
Repeated casting turns the motion into a serial process rather than a single impact.
Tumbling and being flung into a depth gives the cascade a face-directed endpoint.

changed_reading.before: تَدَّعُونَ names what they repeatedly called for or claimed.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, the verdict also names the forceful cascading trajectory that their repeated provocation has drawn into visible presence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because spatial زُلْفَةً normally carries approach, whereas the same inventory also contains filled vessels. It remains anchored in the focus word and is activated by the contextual boiling and near-rending material. Downstream prose should use 'brimming' only as a secondary image for threshold saturation, not as the lexical meaning of زُلْفَةً here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: زُلْفَةً at the point where the seen object reaches and visibly affects their faces

activation_trace.role: The filled-vessel image recasts nearness as a threshold at which contained consequence is brimming over.
The visible fronts are the receiving surface on which that threshold becomes legible.
Boiling and surging provide the contextual material action that activates the full-vessel image.
Near rupture or cutting apart supplies the saturation limit toward which the brimming image moves.

changed_reading.before: The object has come spatially near.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, its nearness is also threshold saturation: what had seemed containable has brimmed into direct facial consequence.

strongest_changes: Final sight reverses the earlier visual audit: the viewers, not the viewed order, now display the defect.
The face becomes involuntary testimony that externalizes a previously concealed and verbally denied stance.
The unseen interval for responsive reverence closes into compelled, too-late recognition.
The timing challenge in 67:25 is answered by visible appointment and deictic presence rather than by a calendar date.
The face-down versus upright-path contrast turns the spoiled faces into endpoints of a misdirected trajectory.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses several reversals into one encounter: observer becomes exposed object, secret stance becomes visible face, unused faculties become compelled recognition, speech becomes present referent, and a challenged future becomes 'this' at close range.
remaining_uncertainties: تَدَّعُونَ remains live between provocative calling or demand and assertion of a claim.
The faces can be literal countenances while also carrying public standing, argument, and directional force; the extensions need not all be equally active.
The cascading-thrust and brimming-nearness outliers are packet-anchored echoes, not proposed lexical substitutions.
The precise antecedent of the seen object is left implicit in the focus and is identified with the challenged threat by contextual sequence.
